steps.title: Prepare Fixative Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 100 ml of 2.0% paraformaldehyde - 2.5% glutaraldehyde in 0.15M sodium cacodylate buffer (pH 7.4) with 2mM CaCl2.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 g paraformaldehyde prills (EMS cat. #19202) into a 125ml Erlenmeyer flask.
Add 30 ml of ddH2O to the flask.
Add 3-5 drops of 1 N NaOH and mix with a stir bar on a heating plate at 60-65°C until the solution clears.
Filter the cleared solution through a #1 Whatman filter using a funnel into a 100 ml graduated cylinder.
Add 50 ml 0.3M cacodylate stock solution (pH 7.4) (Ted Pella, cat # 18851).
Add 10 ml of 25% glutaraldehyde (EM grade) (Ted Pella, Cat. # 18426).
Add 1 mL of 0.204 M CaCl2·2H2O.
Bring total volume to 100 ml with ddH2O and verify pH is 7.4.
Pour into a 100ml Erlenmeyer flask, cover with Parafilm, and maintain at 35°C in a water bath for perfusion.

steps.title: Prepare Ringer's Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 100 ml of Ringer's solution with the following components and additives.

substeps.instruction: Combine 9.9 ml NaCl stock (79.8 g/L; 1.365M), 1.0 ml Na2HPO4 stock (18 g/L; 0.127M), 1.0 ml KCl stock (37.5 g/L; 0.503M), 1.0 ml MgCl2·6H2O stock (20.0 g/L; 0.098M), and 2.5 ml NaHCO3 stock (50.0 g/L; 0.595M).
Add 0.2 grams dextrose.
Bubble 95% air/5% CO2 through the solution at 35°C for at least 5 min.
Add 1.0 ml CaCl2·2H2O stock solution (30.0 g/L; 0.204M).
Add 1.0 mL of 2% Lidocaine and 2.5 mL of 1000U/mL heparin.

steps.title: Set Up Perfusion System
steps.instruction: Prepare the pump and surgical tools for the procedure.

substeps.instruction: Set out large and small scissors, hemostat, tweezers, and iris scissors.
Turn on the pump and allow the fix solution to reach the valve.
Turn the valve to Ringer's and set the pump rate according to animal size, ensuring all air is removed from the line.

steps.title: Anesthetize the Animal
steps.instruction: Administer anesthesia and verify the depth of sedation.

substeps.instruction: Give an intraperitoneal injection of 0.05ml Pentobarbital Sodium (minimal dose 2.5mg/20g mouse; stock 1000mg/20ml).
Verify the needle is in the peritoneal cavity by drawing back to check for air (no blood).
Wait several minutes for the anesthetic to take effect; test depth using tail pinch and paw prick, ensuring breathing does not stop.

steps.title: Perform Heart Perfusion
steps.instruction: Expose the heart and perform the perfusion sequence.

substeps.instruction: Secure the animal's limbs.
Using small scissors and tweezers, lift skin below the rib cage and cut until the liver is visible; cut upward along the body cavity sides until the diaphragm is visible, avoiding organ injury.
Cut the diaphragm and cut upward along the body sides, avoiding damage to the heart and lungs.
Use a hemostat to pull the skin up over the head.
Place a needle into the left ventricle and cut the right atrium with iris scissors.
Turn on the flow of Ringer's solution (heart should beat, liver should turn pale) and perfuse for approximately 1 minute at a rate of 5 mL/minute.
Switch the pump valve to fix solution; the heart should stop beating and the body should stiffen.
Perfuse with fix solution for 10 minutes, then remove the needle from the heart.

steps.title: Harvest and Fix Brain
steps.instruction: Extract the brain for further fixation.

substeps.instruction: Dissect the brain without causing artificial damage.
Place the brain in a vial containing the same fixative and store at 4°C for 2 hours.
